headlines.title: Hegseth says the impeachment push against him is a 'farce' and 'stunt'
headlines.description: Republican Rep. Thomas Massie filed articles of impeachment against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth over the Iran conflict and other military actions. Hegseth dismissed the effort as “a farce” and “a stunt,” calling Massie a “disgruntled” congressman.

headlines.title: Republicans Push to Delay Vote on Congressional Leadership
headlines.description: A new power struggle is emerging on Capitol Hill in the wake of the historic midterm election results, with House and Senate Republicans set to vote on leadership teams for the new Congress. Some GOP senators are now pushing for a delay, pondering whether it’s time for a changing of the guard. NBC’s Ryan Nobles reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Several U.S. aircraft removed from U.K. airbase over Iran threats
headlines.description: Several U.S. military aircraft were relocated from a U.K. airbase amid a security threat linked to Iran. NBC News’ Keir Simmons reports on the latest developments and President Donald Trump’s strategy of a naval blockade.

headlines.title: Nvidia Loses $200B in Value Amid Alleged Chinese Spy Scandal
headlines.description: Nvidia, the world’s most valuable chipmaker, is facing major stock market losses and new scrutiny in Washington where the concern for national security and the demand for answers is growing. NBC’s Brian Cheung reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Russia's last major independent newspaper shuts down citing Kremlin assault on free press
headlines.description: Novaya Gazeta, renowned for uncovering human rights abuses and corruption through fierce reporting, closes its doors after more than three decades. The news outlet says it's shutting down due to government pressure from the Kremlin. NBC News' Matt Bodner reports.

headlines.title: FBI Investigates Suspected Homicide on MSC Seascape Cruise
headlines.description: The FBI says they’re investigating the death of a female passenger aboard the MSC Seascape as a homicide. It comes as authorities have taken a man into custody in connection with the alleged incident. NBC’s Liz Kreutz reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Amazon’s Ring debuts security robots including a drone
headlines.description: Amazon’s Ring has launched an indoor security drone, the company said Tuesday, offering homeowners room-to-room surveillance where a fixed camera cannot reach.

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.

headlines.title: Man charged with murder on cruise says he ‘snapped’ and choked woman, complaint says
headlines.description: A man seen on video being escorted off a cruise ship in Texas after a woman’s body was found in a cabin room told authorities that he repeatedly struck and choked her after they got into an argument, according to a criminal complaint.

headlines.title: Pete Hegseth says impeachment push is a ‘farce’
headlines.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said Tuesday that the effort to impeach him by an outgoing Republican congressman is nothing but a “political spectacle.”

headlines.title: Inflation still a headache for consumers despite cooling last month
headlines.description: Prices rose 0.4% in October, after the average cost of gas eased, bringing some relief to consumers who have been hammered by high prices for most of the year.
